metadata.comparisonRule: The portable window must match within 1e-6 and the portable mel bank within 2e-5 absolute error.
metadata.inputConstruction: window and melWeights are the Float32 BLOBFILE tensors _fbank_window [1,400] and _fbank_mel_weight [80,257,1] decoded from the caller-provided FBank.mlmodelc weights/weight.bin after the 64-byte record header; their model.mil declarations and offsets are checked.
